summary: Harden M36, M666 and M1296 domain validation against malformed types and boolean numeric coercion.
rationale: All four repositories must reject malformed genome structures, bool-as-int identifiers, non-finite numeric values and invalid relation/edge metadata consistently before data reaches shared genome APIs.
verification: Add negative tests for boolean indices and numeric values, malformed M36 objects, invalid enum metadata and graph traversal depth.
Run Python tests, package builds and 36OS database governance checks in CI before merge.
No database migration, credential change or production deployment.
notes: Local traceability copy; canonical record is maintained in 36OS-database.
